row.notes: In Sess_TimeTrialLeaderboard_ActivateTab: mov rax,[rcx] right after mov rcx,[rsi+0x9a0] (rsi = the leaderboard model, +0x9a0 the child list model). rcx is 0 when the child was never created or was already released, and the read faults (F1_25.exe+0x2fcbb09 reading 0, Vm_Dispatch_BindingMessage). Core's time trial leaderboard guard hooks it and, for a null child, continues at site_Sess_TimeTrialLeaderboard_TabDone.

verify.notes: V8621 Static: mov rax,[rcx] at 0x142fcbb09 follows mov rcx,[rsi+0x9a0]; faults on null. Only branches in the function (je/jne) target 0x142fcbaf3; none lands in 0x142fcbb09..0x142fcbb0e. Only push is rsi at entry; sub rsp,0x40 once.
